candidates.snippet: Medvedev reacted to Trump signing the Graham bill on "hellish" sanctions against Russia, saying the US only understands "the language of direct military deterrence". He also urged Russia to go further and effectively nationalize Western assets inside the country. https://t.co/m2k

Ukraine’s 3rd Army Corps posted footage of a string of strikes on Russian military vehicles deep behind the lines, mostly as they move along roads, so the crews get caught in the hits too. https://t.co/ASHxzI9N3E
